title: TLS certificate verification disabled in newClient()
detail: src/aurora/aurora-compute/api/server.go:L17 sets InsecureSkipVerify: true in the tls.Config of the HTTP transport returned by newClient(), disabling TLS certificate validation for all outbound requests and allowing man-in-the-middle attacks.

title: Shell injection via exec.Command("sh","-c",...) in Console()
detail: src/aurora/aurora-compute/api/server.go:L24 constructs a shell command with exec.Command("sh", "-c", fmt.Sprintf("virsh console %s", instance)); the 'instance' parameter is not validated or escaped, so shell metacharacters in the caller's input could inject arbitrary commands.
